author: Ubisoft
description:
The critics have spoken — and Morbid Metal is already live in Early Access. Jump in, shapeshift, and carve your own path.

Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/

Morbid Metal is a roguelite hack'n slash game in which you battle fearsome enemies in a dark sci-fi universe. Instantly switch characters to take advantage of their unique characteristics and perform devastating combos. Every victory makes you stronger, every defeat is an opportunity to progress.

Developed by Screenjuice in Unity and published by Ubisoft.
🔻 Follow the game for updates and exclusive content! 🔻
📌X: https://x.com/MorbidMetalGame
📌 BlueSky: https://web-cdn.bsky.app/profile/screen-juice.com
📌 Discord: https://t.co/iUhDCDVTyf

author: Ubisoft
description:
Time to celebrate the Kensei! We're releasing a Unique Execution for that Hero.

About For Honor:
Step into the battlefield to experience the chaos and glory found only in For Honor. 

Whether battling through a gripping campaign or clashing with others in intense multiplayer modes and PvP modes, players choose from history’s deadliest warriors, each from a fierce rival faction — the bold Knights, the brutal Vikings, the deadly Samurai, the fearsome Wu Lin, and the enigmatic Outlanders. 

For Honor is a fast-paced and immersive experience that continues to evolve with major gameplay updates, new Heroes, thrilling events, and more, keeping the conflict alive and ever challenging.

#Ubisoft #ForHonor

In this second episode of Motorfest Mastery, discover how to master turns with @TRNSPRTR. 
Join us in the next episode to learn how to reach platinum in the Summit!

Discover TRNSPRTR videos right here: https://www.youtube.com/@TRNSPRTR

About The Crew Motorfest:
Welcome to Motorfest! Discover the evergreen festival featuring the best experiences car culture has to offer. Complete your ultimate action driving bucket list through a series of tailor-made races, themed events, and other unique challenges. Explore the vibrant island of O’ahu in Hawaii alone or with your crew. Whatever the way you enjoy cars and driving, there is something in there for you!

About Skull and Bones:
Enter the perilous world of Skull and Bones, where you play by your own rules to rise from a nobody to become the most fearsome pirate kingpin. Craft a variety of unique ships, forge unlikely alliances, and take part in thrilling naval battles as you overcome the odds and bring mayhem on the seas. Be part of an immersive world that introduces new challenges and features every season.
